checklists.name: Docker Containerization Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for multi-stage Dockerfiles, non-root user security, layer caching, and vulnerability scanning.

items.statement: Dockerfiles use multi-stage builds to keep production runtime images minimal and free of build toolchains.
Containers execute under non-root users (USER 10001) with explicit read-only root filesystems where possible.
Base images use minimal distributions (distroless or alpine) with explicit digest / version pinning.
Dockerfile instructions order COPY and RUN commands to maximize layer caching efficiency.
Trivy / Grype image vulnerability scanners execute in CI/CD and block images with critical/high CVEs.

obligationDefinitions.title: Container images must be rebuilt when their base image gets a security patch
obligationDefinitions.description: A container built from a base image is only as current as that base image was at build time; a later CVE patch to the base image does nothing for already-built, still-deployed images unless they are rebuilt and redeployed.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every deployed image is rebuilt from a patched base image within the declared SLA of the base image's advisory.

requiredEvidence.title: Base image vulnerability scan
requiredEvidence.description: Container image scan output showing base-image CVE status.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Automated container image scanning tool output.
